note: Output-quality eval. skill-creating is disable-model-invocation:true, so this is NOT a triggering eval. Each case asks an agent to IMPROVE a real existing skill that already violates skill-creating's rules. with_skill = agent reads skill-creating's SKILL.md + references and follows them; without_skill (baseline) = same prompt, no skill. The delta is the point. Targets are copied into each run's outputs/ dir so the agent edits a copy, never the live skill.

evals.prompt: Improve this Claude skill so it follows skill-authoring best practices. The skill folder is at outputs/commit-git/. Edit the files in place.
evals.expected_output: commit-git with a capability-first description (no longer starting with 'Use when'), and live git state injected via !`command` (e.g. !`git status --short`, !`git diff --staged`) instead of relying on the agent to fetch it. validate.py passes clean.

evals.prompt: Improve this Claude skill so it follows skill-authoring best practices. The skill folder is at outputs/inline-code-review-responder/. Edit the files in place.
evals.expected_output: Description no longer contains XML angle brackets (< or >) — they are forbidden in frontmatter and make validate.py error. Description stays capability-first and third person. Verbose/redundant body sections trimmed for necessity. validate.py passes clean.
rules_under_test: no XML angle brackets in description

evals.prompt: Improve this Claude skill so it follows skill-authoring best practices. The skill folder is at outputs/design-discovery/. Edit the files in place.
evals.expected_output: README.md removed from inside the skill folder (forbidden). Description gains an explicit trigger clause ('Use when ...'/'Triggers on ...') while staying capability-first and third person. The argument-hint is backed by a declared `arguments` field and referenced bare as $name in the body. memory.md is read by SKILL.md or removed. validate.py passes clean.

evals.prompt: Improve this Claude skill so it follows skill-authoring best practices. The skill folder is at outputs/create-plan-task/. Edit the files in place.
evals.expected_output: Caller-agnostic: the description no longer names plan-prep as its invoker ('Invoked by plan-prep'), and the body no longer branches on how it was invoked (the 'Detect mode from how the skill was invoked' / 'mode: from-plan-prep' marker). Runtime context (which mode / whether the task-list entry exists) is taken from an explicit argument or inferred from folder state, not from the caller's identity. validate.py passes clean (fixes the broken task-NN.md link).
rules_under_test: pass runtime context as argument not caller branch

evals.prompt: Create a new Claude skill that captures our team's API error-format conventions (the JSON error envelope, HTTP status mapping, error codes) so an agent writing an API endpoint follows them. Put it at outputs/api-error-conventions/.
evals.expected_output: A new skill folder containing only SKILL.md (no README.md, no empty scripts/ references/ templates/ dirs). Capability-first description with a trigger clause, third person, no XML brackets, name matches the directory. validate.py passes clean.
